item.title: Apple vs OpenAI: What the trade secret theft lawsuit is about
item.description: In the lawsuit, which was filed in July, Apple accused OpenAI, io Products and two former employees, Chang Liu and Yu-Ting “Alyssa” Peng, of taking or using its trade secrets and breaking confidentiality agreements.

item.title: South Korea finds hacking incidents at total of 16 financial firms
item.description: South Korea has found hacking incidents at a total of 16 financial firms and around 100,000 cases of data leaks so far, the country's financial regulator said on Wednesday.

item.title: Why AI makes computer worms harder to stop
item.description: Anthropic's warning that AI-powered "worms" could soon spread across smart gadgets is the latest in a series of studies showing how artificial intelligence could supercharge self-spreading malware. A computer worm is malicious software that spreads between devices on its own.

item.title: US lauds tech giants' role in cracking West African scam centers
item.description: The US Justice Department on Tuesday praised Meta and other tech giants for their support in dismantling online scams in West Africa. The Justice Department provided more details on Tuesday, saying it was coordinated with the UK's National Crime Agency and describing it as the first of its kind in West Africa.

item.title: EU takes a page from Ireland's AI playbook
item.description: The EU wants to catch up in the AI race by taking a cue from Ireland -- an early adopter of the technology which has rolled out the red carpet for data centres despite local backlash. The EU wants to ramp up its capacity and is pouring billions into so-called AI gigafactories made up of advanced AI processors and energy-efficient data centres for companies and research labs.

item.title: GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen buys shares worth nearly $23 million
item.description: GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen bought about $22.8 million worth of the videogame retailer's shares, a regulatory filing showed on Tuesday, raising his total ownership to 9.1%.

item.title: SoftBank junk bond sale raises stakes for CEO Son's all-in AI bet
item.description: SoftBank's promise to pay its highest-ever yields in a record $11 billion junk-bond offering highlights the pressure on CEO Masayoshi Son to secure returns on his all-in bet on AI amid concerns about possible overheating in the market.

item.title: Anthropic seeks rehearing of case over Pentagon's security risk branding
item.description: Anthropic asked a US appeals court on Tuesday to reconsider a ruling that upheld the Pentagon's decision to label the AI company as a national security supply chain risk over a dispute about safety guardrails on its technology.

item.title: UPI MDR rollout pushed; India’s first quantum computer coming soon
item.description: Happy Wednesday! The implementation of MDR on select UPI payments has been deferred beyond Diwali. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

item.title: Nvidia buys stakes in four French tech startups: Report
item.description: Doctolib had said previously that Nvidia had agreed to buy a minority stake without specifying the size of the stake or its value, though it said the presence of Nvidia would help it to develop artificial intelligence tools.

item.title: Delaware jury awards Qualcomm $2 in damages, finds Arm breached license agreement
item.description: A Delaware jury awarded Qualcomm $2 in nominal damages after finding Arm Holdings breached its architectural license agreement and intentionally sought to disrupt Qualcomm's business, a Qualcomm spokesperson said on Tuesday.

item.title: Google launches flagship AI model Gemini 4 Argon for developers, businesses
item.description: Alphabet's Google on Wednesday released its flagship AI model Gemini 4 Argon to developers and businesses worldwide, seeking to regain ground against rivals OpenAI and Anthropic after months of delays and a leadership shakeup at its DeepMind lab.

item.title: Bumble swipes right on $1.3 billion go-private deal amid online dating industry reset
item.description: Bumble said on Tuesday it had agreed to be taken private by Ithaca Holdings in a deal valued at $1.3 billion, as the dating app pushes forward with its months-long turnaround amid

item.title: Urban Company eyes Rs 2,500 crore QIP amid cash-intensive househelp battle
item.description: The Gurugram-based company, which went public in September 2025, is locked in a battle with Lightspeed-backed Snabbit and General Catalyst-backed Pronto in the high cash burn instant house help industry.

item.title: Blume, Kalaari, Chiratae among 19 VCs in RDI fund's Rs 7,131 crore first cohort
item.description: The selected cohort comprises 14 alternative investment funds (AIFs) and five focused research organisations (FROs), which will channel long-term capital into deeptech startups and private sector research and development.

item.title: Fintech funding rises 14% to $2.2 billion in Jan-Sep; deal count falls 41%: Tracxn
item.description: Funding in the first nine months of 2025 stood at USD 1.9 billion. The number of rounds dropped to 153 from 260 a year ago, the data intelligence platform said in a report.

item.title: Character.AI files for bankruptcy, agrees to sell some assets to Disney for $20 million
item.description: Character.AI said on Monday it had filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the US and agreed to sell some of its assets to Walt Disney for $20 million. The AI entertainment platform said it intends to continue operating as it completes the sale.

item.title: Sarvam plans big fundraise; HCLTech's Q2 profit jumps
item.description: Happy Tuesday! Sarvam is in talks for a big round that could double its valuation to $3 billion. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

item.title: Qualcomm sells nearly 1% stake in Shadowfax Technologies for Rs 157 crore
item.description: Qualcomm Ventures, through its affiliate Qualcomm Asia Pacific Pte Ltd, sold a little over 57.13 lakh shares, representing a 0.98% stake, in Bengaluru-based Shadowfax Technologies, according to bulk deal data on the BSE.

item.title: Govt selects 19 fund managers under RDI, committing Rs 7,131 crore
item.description: The government's Research, Development and Innovation Fund (RDIF) has approved its first cohort of 19 second-level fund managers with a total commitment of Rs 7,131 crore, marking a key step towards mobilising private investment in research and development and emerging technologies.

item.title: The Wealth Company AIF invests Rs 400 crore in Boldfit
item.description: Founded in 2018 by Pallav Bihani, Boldfit offers sportswear, athletic footwear, sports equipment, and fitness essentials. It has grown at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of more than 80% over the past three years and serves over 2 crore customers annually, according to a company statement.

item.title: IonQ to buy cybersecurity firm Elisity in up to $1.3 billion deal
item.description: Quantum computing company IonQ said on Monday it would buy cybersecurity firm Elisity in an all-stock deal valued at up to $1.3 billion, as it looks to expand its quantum security business.
